incident.childhood.social_choice: Reach out to the faces above
events.childhood.curious.desc: You study everything with rapt attention.
events.childhood.read.desc: Symbols become words, words become worlds.
events.childhood.explore.desc: Insects are monsters, puddles are oceans.
events.childhood.break_vase.desc: A lesson in consequences, learned the hard way.
events.childhood.social.desc: You discover your effect on others.
events.childhood.befriend.desc: Loyalty is born in shared secrets.
events.childhood.showoff.desc: You learn that charm opens doors.
events.childhood.animals.desc: You learn their language of gesture and patience.
events.childhood.draw.desc: Your sketches capture what adults miss.
events.childhood.storm.desc: Fear is a choice. You choose fascination.
events.childhood.sick.desc: Days of fever blur the world. You emerge changed.
events.childhood.talent.desc: Someone sees something special in you.
events.adolescence.hub.desc: The world beyond the familiar beckons.
events.adolescence.debate.desc: Words are weapons, and you wield them well.
events.adolescence.astronomy.desc: The universe feels both vast and intimate.
events.adolescence.mentor_offer.desc: A chance to learn from the best, but at a cost.
events.adolescence.accept_mentor.desc: The hunger to know burns brighter than fear.
events.adolescence.refuse_mentor.desc: The road not taken haunts your quiet moments.
events.adolescence.adventurer.desc: Maps of distant lands cover your walls.
events.adolescence.stowaway.desc: The captain, impressed by your nerve, puts you to work.
events.adolescence.hunt.desc: The forest teaches patience, precision, and consequence.
events.adolescence.sea_storm.desc: When dawn breaks, the crew nods at you differently.
events.adolescence.wolf.desc: Strength is not always in the killing.
events.adolescence.crafter.desc: Wood, metal, and leather become your vocabulary.
events.adolescence.accident.desc: You learn to work around the limitation.
events.adolescence.rebel.desc: Rules feel like chains. You push back.
events.adolescence.gang.desc: Together you are strong. But the gang's code demands things.
events.adolescence.loner_rebel.desc: The world does not bend to you, but neither do you bend.
events.adolescence.crime.desc: The shopkeeper's terrified face stays with you.
events.adolescence.manifesto.desc: Some call you dangerous. Others call you prophet.
events.adolescence.love.desc: The world suddenly has a center, and it is not you.
events.adolescence.betrayal.desc: The wound is deep because it came from inside the walls.
events.adult.hub.desc: The choices you make now will echo for decades.
events.adult.scholar.desc: Research draws attention, both admiring and envious.
events.adult.publish.desc: Rivals attack. Supporters defend. Your name spreads.
events.adult.independent.desc: The work is harder but belongs to no one but you.
events.adult.frontline.desc: Instinct and reflexes keep you alive.
events.adult.battle.desc: Smoke, steel, and screams. When the field clears, you stand.
events.adult.merchant.desc: Your first investment triples. You taste wealth.
events.adult.expand.desc: Ships bearing your flag cross every ocean.
events.adult.cautious_trade.desc: Competitors who mocked your caution are long gone.
events.adult.artist.desc: Creation consumes you. The truth wrestles into form.
events.adult.recognized.desc: Patrons compete. But does recognition change the art?
events.adult.struggle_artist.desc: Something pure emerges from the struggle.
events.adult.outlaw.desc: The law is a line you step across.
events.adult.enforcer.desc: People fear you. You begin to fear yourself.
events.adult.flee.desc: The past has a way of finding those who bury it.
events.adult.confront.desc: Bloodied but standing — and finally free.
events.adult.everyman.desc: There is dignity in honest labor.
events.adult.family.desc: Small joys accumulate like compound interest.
events.adult.trade_skill.desc: Your hands know what your mind no longer needs to think.
events.adult.war.desc: Everything you built sits in its path.
events.adult.crisis.desc: The easy wrong or the hard right. No one is watching.
events.twilight.hub.desc: The end is no longer an abstract concept.
events.twilight.succeed.desc: The world takes notice one final time.
events.twilight.fail.desc: In the attempt, you discovered yourself.
events.twilight.family.desc: You watch the next generation step forward.
events.twilight.solitude.desc: Peace settles into your bones like a long-awaited guest.
events.twilight.community.desc: What you took, you now return multiplied.
events.twilight.gamble.desc: Fortune favors the bold — or so you tell yourself.
events.twilight.power.desc: The view from the top is vertigo-inducing.
events.twilight.wealth.desc: Every coin a monument. But the counting brings less joy.
events.twilight.atone.desc: You reach for the handle of a door that opens only inward.
events.twilight.reform.desc: Some forgive. Some do not. Both responses are earned.
events.twilight.help_others.desc: Every small rescue redeems a piece of your past.
events.twilight.reflection.desc: The ledger of your life. The totals tell a story only you can read.
events.ending.scholar.desc: Your treatises reshape human knowledge. The world thinks differently because you existed.
events.ending.visionary.desc: Nations follow the path you charted. Your vision outlasts empires.
events.ending.artisan.desc: Your creations outlive centuries. Each piece whispers your devotion.
events.ending.hero.desc: They sing songs of your victories. The battlefield remembers your courage.
events.ending.sage.desc: Generations seek your counsel. Your wisdom becomes tradition.
events.ending.farmer.desc: The earth you tilled remembers. Seasons passed in quiet rhythm.
events.ending.parent.desc: Your children carry your love forward into the world.
events.ending.merchant.desc: A life of fair deals and quiet prosperity. Your handshake was your bond.
events.ending.teacher.desc: Knowledge passed, one student at a time. Ripples spread beyond measure.
events.ending.servant.desc: You served something greater than yourself. In service, you found meaning.
events.ending.consumption.desc: Disease claims you before your time. The cough that would not leave.
events.ending.war.desc: The battlefield takes everything. Your last thought was of home.
events.ending.betrayed.desc: Those you trusted most destroy you. The knife was held by a friend.
events.ending.prisoner.desc: The cell walls become your world. Years blur into grey stone.
events.ending.destitute.desc: Hunger and cold are your final companions. The world moved on without you.
events.ending.bureaucrat.desc: Buried under the paperwork you created. Form 7C remains unsigned.
events.ending.tyrant.desc: You became what you swore to destroy. The revolutionary's statue wears a crown.
events.ending.prophet.desc: Your disciples realize you were ordinary all along. The temple empties.
events.ending.miser.desc: You die clutching your fortune, alone. The coins are cold against your chest.
events.ending.fame.desc: The crowd's adoration suffocates you. The applause never stopped.
events.ending.reformed.desc: From darkness, you walked into light. Every step was a battle won.
events.ending.late_bloomer.desc: Success came when all seemed lost. The final chapter was the brightest.
events.ending.sacrifice.desc: Your death saves countless others. One life, freely given, changes everything.
events.ending.sage_mountain.desc: Peace found in solitude, wisdom shared freely. The mountain asked nothing.
events.ending.letter.desc: One act of kindness changes everything. A letter finds its recipient at last.
